programs.language: English (programme page: 'Taught in English'); a B2-level Spanish certificate is required before the start of the 3rd year, so clinical years assume Spanish
programs.feb_start_evidence: Official UCAM news of 18/01/2024 lists 'Odontología (Inglés, Cartagena)' first among the 'Grados con posibilidad de matriculación' for students starting in the second semester (Feb 2024). It is NOT in the January 2025 list (15/01/2025) or the January 2026 list (12/01/2026). Those two lists contain only Spanish-taught in-person grados plus the semipresencial/online offer. No February 2027 announcement yet: UCAM publishes the list in mid-January each year. UCAM 2026/27 calendars: 2nd-semester classes start 1 Feb 2027.
programs.application_deadline: NOT FOUND for Feb 2027. Past second-semester windows ran from mid-January to 28 Feb 2025 or 'hasta final de febrero' 2026, which is far too late for a visa. The English-programme pages give no deadline.
programs.application_fee_text: Fee box on international.ucam.edu programme pages: Application fee 150€; Pre-Inscription fee 390€; Opening of academic records 450€; Student insurance 96,12€. 'The application, pre-inscription and reservation fees are non-refundable' (refund policy says except for visa denial for the reservation fee, see refund_text). Pre-enrolment fee is 'NOT refundable under any circumstances' (Finance Division Regulations art. 3).
programs.deposit_text: The official pages do not say exactly which amount is due before the admission letter. Charged at the application/pre-enrolment stage: application fee €150 + pre-inscription €390 (= €540). A 'reservation fee' is also charged; for international/English programmes its amount is not published. The general UCAM rule (Finance Regulations art. 4/6) is that new students pay part of the enrolment fee in advance as a reservation fee. In the domestic rules the non-refundable cancellation amount is €2,000 for Medicine/Dentistry and €1,100 for other grados. International students and English-taught programmes follow the separate international refund policy.
programs.refund_text: UCAM international Refund Policy (applies to all applicants who accepted a place): 'A refund of the reservation fee will be issued if an applicant is unable to take their place due to a student visa denial (administrative fees are non-refundable), provided that: the visa application is valid (genuine documents, required financial resources and qualifications); the visa application is timely (applied before the start date of the program); proof/documentary evidence of their visa refusal is provided.' Application fees and pre-inscription payments are non-refundable in all cases unless the university is at fault. No refunds after the programme start date. That includes a visa applied for after the start date and then refused. Other cancellations: more than 28 days before start, 20% of the reservation fee is kept plus the application and pre-inscription fees; within 28 days, nothing is refunded. Withdrawal must be in writing to the International Admissions Office (admissions@ucam.edu). Refund form required; processed within about 6 weeks; Flywire payments are refunded via Flywire; transfer costs are not covered. The PDF shows no date.
programs.tuition_text: Programme page: 'TUITION FEES PER YEAR 253.33 €/ECTS — 15,200 €/Curso' (60 ECTS). Same price shown for all nationalities; no non-EU surcharge stated. The academic year of the figure is not stated on the page (fetched 2026-10-04).
programs.graduate_route: UCAM Normativa de Acceso 2026/27 art. 2: access route 10 covers university graduates with Spanish or equivalent degrees. Route 11 covers students with foreign university studies, partial or completed, without Spanish homologation: 'será requisito indispensable que esta Universidad les haya reconocido al menos 30 créditos'. A Business Computing degree is unlikely to yield 30 ECTS in Dentistry. The realistic route is the secondary-school path the international pages ask for (High School transcript/diploma/national exam), with a UNEDasiss credential or homologation of the school diploma; the pre-enrolment guide asks for the same document number 'used for UNED or Homologation procedure'. Art. 25 also keeps a 10% extra quota for transfers and for students with ≥30 ECTS recognised. Foreign documents must be legalised/apostilled and translated.
programs.language_requirement: 'A B2 English level is required to be admitted in this Degree. You can provide any language proficiency certificate from this list. Any other English certificate will be evaluated individually.' Also: 'B2-level Spanish certificate required prior to the start of the 3rd year.'
programs.official_ruct: Yes (per university page — official Grado en Odontología; RUCT code not checked)
programs.data_year: Fees: academic year not stated on page (current page fetched 2026-10-04). Feb-entry evidence: 2023-24 only — POSSIBLY OUTDATED
programs.visa_timing_note: Unlikely. UCAM only announces its second-semester list in mid-January (18 Jan 2024, 15 Jan 2025, 12 Jan 2026), and the English Dentistry group was missing from the last two lists. An admission letter by early Dec 2026 would need individual written confirmation from UCAM International Admissions (admissions@ucam.edu) that an English-group February 2027 entry exists.
programs.risks: Feb entry for the English group appears only in the 2024 list, so it is very likely discontinued. The field is unrelated to the applicant's (Business Computing). It is a 5-year health degree with clinical sequencing, so a mid-year entry may leave first-year annual subjects incomplete. Spanish B2 is needed by year 3. Tuition is high (€15,200/yr). A foreign-graduate entry via 30 ECTS recognition is unlikely, so a secondary-school credential via UNEDasiss/homologation would be needed. The reservation fee is refundable on visa denial only if the visa was applied for before the programme start date. Application and pre-inscription fees (€540) are never refundable.

notes: ENGLISH/FRENCH REQUIREMENT APPLIED (coordinator update). Result for this group: NO confirmed in-person, English- or French-taught official grado with a February 2027 start for new students. (1) UCAM (Murcia/Cartagena) is the only university in this group with a real, recurring February start for NEW grado students: lists published 18/01/2024, 15/01/2025 and 12/01/2026; enrolment open to end of February; classes from the 2nd semester (1 Feb 2027 in the 2026/27 calendars). In 2025 and 2026, however, the in-person grados on those lists were all Spanish-taught. Business and IT entries were Marketing y Dirección Comercial (presencial), Telecom Engineering (presencial), and ADE and Informática only online. The single English-taught entry ever listed was Odontología (Inglés, Cartagena) in Jan 2024; it is recorded in programs as UNCLEAR. UCAM also announces the list only in mid-January, too late for a December visa letter unless International Admissions confirms individually. (2) UCAM money rules worth knowing even for a September plan: application €150 + pre-inscription €390 (never refundable); opening of records €450; insurance €96.12. The reservation fee is deducted from tuition and refunded on visa denial if the visa was applied for before the programme start date, with genuine documents and proof of refusal. Withdraw in writing to admissions@ucam.edu; refund in about 6 weeks. Normativa 2026/27 art. 23: NO-UE students and English programmes have a specific refund policy. Foreign graduates without homologation need ≥30 ECTS recognised (access route 11); otherwise they enter on the school-leaving credential (UNEDasiss/homologation). (3) CEU group: CEU San Pablo (BBA in English €13,500/yr, reservation €950), CEU UCH (English and French tracks in Veterinary, Dentistry, Medicine etc.) and CEU Fernando III are all September-only. CEU UCH's rules explicitly deny refunds of academic fees for visa refusal for international students. (4) UFV: English tracks (Computer Engineering €12,465/yr, Business Analytics, Economics & Finance, IR; French-bilingual Physiotherapy) are September 2027 only. (5) The rest (Comillas, Navarra, Deusto, Mondragon, UCV, UNEATLANTICO, UEMC, UPSA, Loyola, UNIE, UIE, USJ, EUNEIZ, UE Valencia, UE Canarias) are September/October only. Second-semester entry appears only in online or hybrid modes: UCAM online/semipresencial, UCAV hybrid/virtual (2nd window 16 Nov 2026–1 Mar 2027), Atlántico Medio virtual. Online-only universities (UNIR, VIU, UDIMA, Isabel I, UTAMED, UOC) are rejected; UOC and UCAV-virtual clearly have February entry. Limitations: Deusto, USJ, Loyola and UNIR block automated fetching; Pessoa-Canarias is behind a captcha. The session web-search budget ran out mid-sweep, so some negatives (UPSA, EUNEIZ, Pessoa-Canarias) are weak. Nothing suggests a February English intake at any of them. Contacts: UCAM International Admissions admissions@ucam.edu, enquiries@ucam.edu, +34 968 27 88 83 (international), info@ucam.edu / +34 968 27 88 00 (general), gestioneconomica@ucam.edu (finance). CEU UCH international@uchceu.es. UFV info@ufv.es, +34 91 324 80 64. UCAV estudiaconnosotros@ucavila.es. Suggested action: email admissions@ucam.edu asking whether any English-taught grado (BBA, Dentistry Cartagena, Sport Sciences, Psychology) will admit new first-year or transfer students in February 2027, and whether a conditional admission letter can be issued by early December 2026.
